images.alt: Каноэ у озера Пилчикоча в амазонском лесу — иллюстрация
images.prompt: Wide 16:9 photorealistic editorial illustration premium travel hero of Pilchicocha blackwater lake in Ecuadorian Amazon near Sacha Lodge Rio Napo. Broad serene dark tea-colored reflective lake surrounded entirely by dense lowland rainforest with layered green canopy, one modest narrow wooden canoe and paddle resting along a simple small timber landing at right foreground, subtle glimpse of low thatched lodge roof among trees far right, no giant buildings. Warm early morning light and faint mist above still water, believable lush primary Amazon vegetation, no mountains or mangrove ocean, no people or oversized animals. Lake and forest reflections at left for title. No text watermark montage.
